reviews.title: very helpful!
reviews.text: I’m new here but for now I received comforting words that helped me see through differently.. I’m new to dating- very new! so the psychic assigned to me really encouraged me to dive more into me than thinking of it as a final no return button
reviews.reply: Hi there, Thank you for opening up about your experience as you begin this new chapter! We’re happy the supportive words you received brought you comfort and a new perspective. If you ever want more encouragement or have questions along the way, just reach out to support-appstore@asknebula.com. Trust in the journey, Nebula
